resources.string: Add this device in Syncthing on your other device, then share a folder with the same folder ID. Both devices must accept the pairing. Only directly accessible local folders are supported.

Syncthing applies changes directly without a file preview and keeps conflict copies. Two-way sync propagates deletions in both directions. Send-only sends local changes and deletions; remote changes may prevent completion. Both devices must be online during a run.
Keep versions of files changed by peers
Could not configure Syncthing. Check the device ID and folder ID; each profile needs a separate local folder and folder ID.
Select a writable, directly accessible local folder for Syncthing.
Use public discovery and relays for Internet sync (shares device ID and IP address). Leave off for local network only.
Android may interrupt a session. Retries use an increasing delay. After the retry limit, the next scheduled or manual run can continue.
Syncthing could not complete the operation: %1$s
Remove this device from all shared folders? Local files will remain.
Android battery optimization or background restrictions may delay synchronization. Review this app’s battery settings if needed. Scheduled work still follows Android limits.
Session network traffic: received %1$s · sent %2$s (includes protocol overhead)
File lists show up to 100 recent entries; peer lists show up to 50. They are samples, not a complete audit. Saved observations may be stale.
Retry requested no earlier than %1$s; Android constraints still apply
Conflict copies remain ordinary files you can review in the folder. Up to 1,000 saved versions are listed. Version recovery runs locally with peers paused.
Lowering retention may delete older versions. Versioning protects files changed by peers, not local edits.
Some folders could not be read or the scan limit was reached. This list is incomplete.
Restore %1$s from %2$s? This replaces the current file. The next sync may send the restored file to peers.
Import an encrypted WizeFiles backup, config.xml, or a Syncthing configuration ZIP. Backups contain configuration and device identity, not your files, retained file versions, or sync history.
Use at least 12 characters and enter the same password twice. Keep it safely; it cannot be recovered.
Enter the password used to encrypt this backup.
Review every local path. Imported folders start paused. Only compatible settings are imported; GUI credentials, automatic upgrades and introducer behavior are excluded.
The original private key is unavailable. This app’s identity will be used; pair it on the other devices.
Stop the original Syncthing app before using its identity here. Otherwise, this app keeps its current identity and must be paired on the other devices.
Replace the current Syncthing configuration? Existing profiles and their history will be removed after the import commits. Your local files remain. Review the imported folders before enabling them.
Import completed. Device ID: %1$s. Imported folders are paused; enable each folder when ready.
